chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa'id al-Hasan ibn Ali al-'Adawi narrated to us in the year 317 AH when he was 107 years old. He said: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Tufawi narrated to us. He said: Qays ibn al-Rabi' narrated to us. He said: Sa'd al-Khaffaf narrated to us from 'Atiyya al-'Awfi, from Makhduj ibn Zayd al-Dhuhli,

that the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) established brotherhood bonds among the Muslims, then said: O 'Ali! You are my brother, and you are to me as Harun was to Musa, except that there is no prophet after me.

Did you not know, O 'Ali, that the first to be called on the Day of Resurrection will be me? I will stand to the right of the Throne and be dressed in a green garment from the garments of Paradise. Then our father Ibrahim (peace be upon him) will be called, and he will stand to the right of the Throne in its shade, and he will be dressed in a green garment from the garments of Paradise. Then the prophets will be called one after another, and they will stand in two rows to the right of the Throne in its shade, and they will be dressed in green garments from the garments of Paradise.

Surely, I inform you, O 'Ali, that my nation will be the first of nations to be reckoned with on the Day of Resurrection. Then I give you glad tidings, O 'Ali, that the first to be called on the Day of Resurrection will be you. This is because of your closeness to me and your rank with me. My banner will be handed to you — it is the Banner of Praise — and you will walk with it between the two rows.

Truly, Adam and all whom God has created will be shaded by the shade of my banner on the Day of Resurrection. Its height is the travel distance of one thousand years. Its tip is a red ruby, its shaft is shining white silver, and its finial is a green pearl. It has three tassels of light: one tassel in the East, one tassel in the West, and one tassel in the middle of the world.

Written on it are three lines: the first: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful; the second: Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds; the third: There is no god but God, Muhammad is the Messenger of God. The length of each line is the travel distance of one thousand years, and its width is the travel distance of one thousand years.

You will walk with the banner, with al-Hasan to your right and al-Husayn to your left, until you stand between me and Ibrahim in the shade of the Throne. Then you will be dressed in a green garment from the garments of Paradise. Then a caller will call out from the Throne: 'How excellent is your father Ibrahim, and how excellent is your brother 'Ali.' Surely, I give you glad tidings, O 'Ali: you will be called as I am called, you will be dressed as I am dressed, and you will be greeted as I am greeted.

key_terms.السِّمَاطَيْنِ: The two rows — referring to the rows of prophets, the saved, or worshippers standing in formation on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.حُلَّةٌ خَضْرَاءُ: A green garment — a reward of Paradise indicating honor, bestowed upon the highest in rank on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.لِوَاءُ الْحَمْدِ: Banner of Praise — the eschatological standard that the Prophet will carry on the Day of Resurrection, now given to Ali
key_terms.مَنْزِلَةُ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى: The rank of Harun from Musa — a well-known prophetic formula indicating Ali's vicegerency in relation to the Prophet, cited in many chains

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to Ali about the Banner of Praise on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In this narration from the Amali of al-Saduq, the Prophet (SAWW) reveals to Imam Ali (AS) the honors that await both of them on the Day of Resurrection. The Prophet describes how he will be the first to be called to stand at the right of the Throne and receive a green garment, followed by Ibrahim and then all the prophets. He then gives Ali the glad tidings that Ali will be the first from among the Prophet's nation to be called, will be handed the Banner of Praise (Liwaa al-Hamd), and will receive the same honors as the Prophet. This narration underscores the elevated spiritual station of Imam Ali (AS) and his unique proximity to the Prophet, reinforcing the Shia theological principle of the Imamate's divine distinction.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (ra) narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa`id al-Hasan b. `Ali al-`Adawi narrated to me in 317 AH when he was 107 years old. He said: Al-Hasan b. Ahmad al-Tafawi narrated to us. He said: Qays b. al-Rabi` narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. al-Khaffaf narrated to us from `Atiyya al-`Awfi from al-Makhduj b. Zayd al-Dhahli.
The Messenger of Allah (s) made brotherhood bonds between the Muslims, then said: O `Ali! You are my brother. You are to me as Harun was to Musa, except there is no prophet after me.

Did you know, `Ali, that the first to be called for on the Day of Resurrection will be me? I will then stand from the right of the Throne, and I will be gowned in a green garment from the garments of Paradise. Then, our father Ibrahim (as) will be called for, and he will then stand from the right of the Throne into its shade, and he will be gowned in a green garment from the garments of Paradise. Then, the prophets will be called for, one after the other, so they will then stand from the right of the Throne into its shade, and they will be gowned in green garments from the garments of Paradise.

Shall I not inform you, `Ali, that my Nation will be the first nation to be judged on the Day of Resurrection? I give you glad tidings, `Ali, that the first [from my Nation] to be called for on the Day of Resurrection is you. This is due to your proximity in relation to me and your status in relation to mine. My banner will be given to you, and it is the Banner of Praise, and you will walk with it between the pillars.

Surely, Adam, and all who Allah created will be shaded by the shade of my banner on the Day of Resurrection. Its height is the travel distance of one thousand years. Its hooks are of red ruby, its pole is of shining silver, and its finial is of green pearl. It has three emblems of light: an emblem in the East, an emblem in the West, and an emblem in the middle of the world.

There are three lines written on it: (1) In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. (2) Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds. (3) There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. The length of each line is the travel distance of one thousand years, and its width is the travel distance of one thousand years.

You will walk with the banner, with al-Hasan to your right and al-Husayn to your left, until you stand between me and Ibrahim in the shade of the Throne. Then, you will be gowned in a green garment from the garments of Paradise. Then, a caller will call from the Throne: “The best of fathers is your father Ibrahim, and the best of brothers is your brother `Ali.” Surely, and I give you glad tidings, `Ali: you will be called for in the same way that I am called for, you will be gowned in the same way that I am gowned, and you will be greeted in the same way that I am greeted.
